## Short description (≤ 350 chars, used by PyPI / GitHub)

Enterprise AI Agent Framework for the modern office. FastAPI + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind 4.
Streaming chat, multi-agent teams with consensus, RAG, memory, named ContextStore, colloquial-Chinese
intent normalizer, 4 ready-made enterprise agent presets, code sandbox, 30+ office tools.
Plug in OpenAI / Anthropic / DeepSeek / Ollama — ready for the enterprise in under a minute.
